description: A Java class named ComponentMetaDataDecorator that extends WebSpanDecorator.StandardTags, used to add and log component-specific metadata tags to an OpenTracing span during HTTP request processing within a web server context.

classes.name: ComponentMetaDataDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that adds component-specific tags and logs to an OpenTracing span during HTTP request processing, including request metadata tagging, reroute logging, response status setting, and error logging.

methods.name: ComponentMetaDataDecorator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with optional custom tags, creating an unmodifiable map of tags.

methods.name: onRequest
methods.description: Sets HTTP method and URL tags on the span and adds custom tags when an HTTP request is received.

methods.name: onReroute
methods.description: Logs a reroute event with request method and URL to the span.

methods.name: onResponse
methods.description: Sets the HTTP status code on the span based on the response.

methods.name: onFailure
methods.description: Logs an error to the span when request processing fails.
